data.hook: Charcoal Bullpadel leggings with side pockets for your spare ball.
why: Side pockets that hold a padel ball or phone
Stretch fit that moves with you
Ankle-length, in a dark charcoal "caviar" shade
data.summary: Bullpadel Tomin women's leggings in a dark caviar shade, with handy side pockets. Comfortable for cooler mornings on court.

faq.q: Can I try the leggings on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new. Perfect for winter mornings.
